in_marathi.name: Dheraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ruler, King, Master
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dheraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dheraj is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dhi’ meaning intellect and ‘raja’ meaning king. This name is a tribute to wise and powerful rulers in Hindu mythology and history. It signifies leadership, strength, and intelligence.
